contact.subGreatings: I'm a Front-end Developer specializing in building modern, responsive, and user-centric web applications. I transform complex ideas into elegant digital experiences
contact.aboutMeResume: My passion for technology started early, inspired by growing up with a programmer in the family. Today, as a Computer Science student and an IT Technician, I work as a Front-end React Developer focused on building high-performance web applications. From modernizing legacy fiscal systems to handling massive data integrations, I value clean code, responsive design, and solid teamwork. I'm highly communicative and currently proudly mentoring a new developer on my team as I step into my next professional level.
contact.aboutMeFirstCardContent: Crafting intuitive, responsive, and highly accessible web interfaces, backed by clean architecture and maintainable code.
contact.aboutMeSecondCardContent: Experience connecting complex backends, handling massive data payloads, and creating real-time ECharts dashboards with third-party APIs like Serpro.
contact.aboutMeThirdCardContent: Delivering real-world solutions at tknow/gxMed, maintaining critical legacy systems (fiscal notes), and mentoring interships team members.

projects.firstProjectDescription: Interactive sports car gallery built with pure (Vanilla) HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project highlights DOM manipulation for dynamic slide switching, advanced CSS animations with spatial (3D) transformations, and a responsive mobile layout.
projects.secondProjectDescription: A seasonal web layout developed with semantic HTML and modern CSS. The project demonstrates advanced structuring techniques using CSS Grid and Flexbox, emphasizing mobile-first responsiveness, fluid image framing with object-fit and aspect-ratio, and custom UI styling to create a cohesive user experience.
